definitions.explanation: A statement about what will happen in the future, typically based on analysis or data.

examples.japanese: ⟦{地震|じしん}→地震：01608_jishin⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{予測|よそく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{難|むずか}しい→難しい：00517_muzukashii⟧。
⟦{専門家|せんもんか}→専門家：03088_senmonka⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{予測|よそく}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦よると→よる：09857_yoru⟧、⟦{経済|けいざい}→経済：01394_keizai⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: According to experts' forecasts, the economy will recover.

examples.japanese: {予測|よそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たった→当たる：01860_ataru⟧。
examples.notes: 予測が当たる = prediction proves correct

notes:
USAGE: {予測|よそく} is often used in technical, scientific, or analytical contexts. It implies a more systematic or data-based prediction compared to ⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧.

COMMON PATTERNS:
・{予測|よそく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to predict, forecast)
・{予測|よそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{当|あ}たる→当たる：01860_ataru⟧ (prediction proves correct)
・{予測|よそく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{外|はず}れる→外れる：02395_hazureru⟧ (prediction proves wrong)
・{予測|よそく}⟦{不能|ふのう}→不能：28353_funou⟧ (unpredictable)

CONTRAST:
・⟦{予想|よそう}→予想：03664_yosou⟧ - expectation (general, informal)
・{予測|よそく} - prediction (analytical, technical)
